column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_recipeviewer.prx (see re/documented.tsv for the columns; registry ids carry the module prefix, addresses here do not).

column3: summary
Returns 0; the 8-byte body sits at module offset 0, and its address (0) is what the module compares callback pointers against. No side effects. No direct caller.

column2: void deck_recipe_viewer_start(uchar mode, int *params, uchar own_reader, int owner)
column3: Sub-module start of the deck-recipe viewer. Clears the 7000-byte work block 0x0000c5e0, copies the 5-word parameter block (heap 0x0000e11c, card reader 0x0000e120, word 0x0000e124, save callback 0x0000e128, load callback 0x0000e12c), stores mode (0 browse, 1 choose a stored-deck slot to save into, 2 choose a deck to load) in the low nibble of 0x0000c5e0, own_reader in bit 0 and "owner != 1" in bit 1 of 0x0000c81d and owner in 0x0000c81e; creates an FPL of 0x468000 bytes for the heap when none was given. In owner mode it loads the owner's original slot recipe into the 0xc0-byte deck buffer 0x0000c820 (deck_load_slot_recipe(owner, 0x0000c820)) and lists only the owner's first recipe (deck_get_owner_recipe(owner, 0)) when its save recipe entry bit 0 is set; otherwise it lists every recipe 1-461 with a level whose save entry bit 0 is set (8-byte records 0x0000c902: recipe, number, entry bits 1-8, owned and total counts from deck_recipe_viewer_count_owned_copies) and the 50 stored decks (records 0x0000d772). Then starts the resource load (0x0000557c), loads music bank 0x2c8 when sound 2 is not playing, sets font options by language and starts the state machine (mode 1 skips the import scan; otherwise save_import_begin). Returns nothing. Side effects: work block, heap/FPL, audio, save import. Callers: exported; module callers via import stubs: rel_story (1: world_state_start_recipe_viewer), rel_deck (1: deck_run_recipe_viewer), rel_title (1: ui_title_update_recipe_viewer).

Sub-module update. Does nothing while the OSK runs (0x0000c5e4 bit 1); runs the card viewer while 0x0000c5e5 bit 2 is set; otherwise steps the reveal counter and either updates the open dialog (deck_recipe_viewer_update_dialog; a non-zero result fades out to state 6) or dispatches on the state (bits 4-11 of 0x0000c5e0): 0 import scan and resource wait, 1 tab/title frames, first deck view, fade in and music track 2, 2 wait for fade, 3 list input, 4 card input, 5 save to slot, 6 wait for fade, 7 release resources. In state 7, once released, returns -2 when cancelled, the selected index for mode 1, index | tab << 16 for mode 2, -2 for mode 0. Returns -1 while running. Side effects: state machine, fades, music, saves through callbacks. Callers: exported; module callers via import stubs: rel_story (1: world_state_update_recipe_viewer), rel_deck (1: deck_run_recipe_viewer), rel_title (1: ui_title_update_recipe_viewer).

Teardown steps on 0x0000c5e2: 0 with an own card reader (0x0000c81d bit 0) closes the card view and asks the reader to stop (step 1), else goes to step 2; 1 waits for card_db_cip_is_idle; 2 frees the resources (0x000058fc, own reader only), the import buffer 0x0000d904 and the FPL, and resets the pad repeat (system_pad_init_repeat). Returns 1 when done, 0 while waiting. Side effects: frees, card view, pad repeat. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_update).

Import step (state 0) on 0x0000c5e2: 0 save_import_update_scan(1, &count 0x0000d908) until done; 1 with decks allocates and clears a 0x1c000-byte buffer 0x0000d904, without decks skips to the end; 2 save_import_update_load(buffer, &count) until done; 3 builds an 8-byte record at 0x0000d90c + 8 x i for each imported deck (0x1c0 bytes each, deck struct at +0x100) with deck_recipe_viewer_count_owned_copies; then clears the step and sets state 1. Returns nothing. Side effects: import buffer, records, state. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_update).

Deck-list input (state 3), list of the current tab (0x0000c5ea bits 0-1: 0 stored decks, 1 recipes, 2 imported decks; first visible u16 0x0000c5ec + 4 x tab, cursor row +2, 8 rows). Holding Up/Down accelerates the pad repeat. Cancel sets the cancelled bit, fades out and goes to state 6 (sound 0x7a06). Confirm by mode: mode 1 on an empty slot goes to state 5 (save), on a used slot opens dialog 2; mode 2 opens dialog 1 for a used stored deck, and a dialog (type hidden by Ghidra) for a valid recipe or imported deck; mode 0 on a used stored deck opens the options menu (dialog 5). R or Square / L cycle the tabs when more than one exists (sound 0x7a0d); Right enters the card view (state 4); Up/Down move the cursor and scroll with wrap. Any cursor change reloads the deck view and resets the card cursor and reveal counter. Returns nothing. Side effects: cursor fields, state, dialogs, sounds. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_update).

Card-view input (state 4) over 7 rows (0-3 main, 4-5 extra, 6 side; row 0x0000c5f9, column 0x0000c5f8): cancel returns to the list (state 3, sound 0x7a06); confirm on a card sets 0x0000c5e5 bit 2 to run the card viewer (sound 0x7a05); Left at column 0 returns to the list, else moves left; Right, Up and Down move inside the row widths (deck_recipe_viewer_get_row_columns). Then updates the text-panel card. Returns nothing. Side effects: cursor, state, sounds. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_update).

Card viewer steps on 0x0000c5e2: 0 fade out; 1 when done opens the viewer on the cursor card (ui_card_viewer_open with two resources, ui_card_viewer_set_pack_source(resource 0x8015), ui_card_viewer_enable_artwork_select) and sets 0x0000c5e5 bit 3; 2 runs ui_card_viewer_update until done, clears bit 3 and fades in; 3 waits, then clears the step and bit 2. Returns nothing. Side effects: fades, viewer, flags. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_update).

Save into a stored-deck slot (state 5) on 0x0000c5e2: 0 blinks the cursor for 18 frames (0x0000c5e5 bit 4); 1 calls the save callback 0x0000e128(slot) when set, rebuilds the slot's record (0x0000d772 + 8 x slot) from save_get_stored_deck, reloads the deck view and resets the card cursor and reveal counter; 2 opens dialog 3 and returns to state 3. Returns nothing. Side effects: stored deck through the callback, records, dialog. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_update).

Sets the play range of the title animation (resource 0x1011) by mode: 2 frames 0x50-0x95, 1 frames 0-0x45, 0 frames 0xa0-0xe5. Returns nothing. Side effects: EHF state. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_update).

Sets the play range of the tab animation (resource 0x1010) to frame f .. f + 1: f = 6 in owner mode, 5 in mode 1, else the tab (0-2) plus 2 when imported decks exist. Returns nothing. Side effects: EHF state. Callers: 2 (deck_recipe_viewer_handle_list_input, deck_recipe_viewer_update).

column2: int deck_recipe_viewer_calc_row_columns(int rows, int count, int min)
column3: Columns per row for count cards over rows rows: count when count < min, min when count < min x rows, else ceil(count / rows). No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_load_selected_deck).

Builds the deck view 0x0000c5fe (0x21e bytes) for the selected entry of the current tab: an imported deck (buffer +0x100 of record i), a recipe (deck_load_recipe and deck_get_recipe_card_list) or a used stored deck (struct at +0x54, card list at +0x114), with deck_recipe_viewer_build_deck_view; clears it when nothing is selected. Counts main and extra entries per frame category into the 7 u16 counters 0x0000e10c (shop_get_frame_style_index) and sets the main and extra columns per row (0x0000c5fa with 4 rows, 0x0000c5fc with 2 rows, minimum 7). Returns nothing. Side effects: deck view, counters. Callers: 3 (deck_recipe_viewer_handle_list_input, deck_recipe_viewer_save_to_slot, deck_recipe_viewer_update).
qsort comparator for card ids: by card_db_get_frame, equal frames by card_db_get_sort_position. Returns the difference. No side effects. No direct caller (passed to system_qsort).

Collects the main, side and extra ids of a 0xc0-byte deck struct, sorts them (deck_recipe_viewer_compare_cards) and counts owned copies against save_get_card_count (or, in owner mode, deck_get_other_deck_card_allowance(owner, id, 0x0000c820)): the first copy of an id counts when any is owned, each further copy k while the owned count differs from k (hypothesis, medium: intended as copies owned). Stores that count at record +5 and the total card count at record +6. Returns nothing. Side effects: record. Callers: 3 (deck_recipe_viewer_start, deck_recipe_viewer_save_to_slot, deck_recipe_viewer_scan_imported_decks).

Fills the 0x21e-byte deck view from a deck struct: header u16 (bits 0-6 main count, 7-10 side count, 11-15 extra count) and sorted 6-byte entries (id, image index from shop_find_in_sorted_table(id, resource 0x8031), flags) for main (+2), side (+0x16a) and extra (+0x1c4). Main and side entries get byte 5 bit 5 when key_list contains the id (deck_card_list_contains). Every entry gets byte 5 bit 1 (available) while the owned copies (save_get_card_count, or deck_get_other_deck_card_allowance in owner mode) exceed the copies of the same image already placed; outside owner mode a further 0x000062b8(id) count can also make it available, then marked with byte 4 bit 7. Returns nothing. Side effects: view. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_load_selected_deck).

Deletes the selected stored deck: clears word 0 (used flag) of save_get_stored_deck(index) and the owned/total bytes of its record 0x0000d772 + 8 x index. Returns nothing. Side effects: save stored deck, record. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_update_dialog).

When the selected stored deck is used, opens the on-screen keyboard on its name (stored deck +4) with title word 0x6a and 16 characters (ui_start_osk_input, no callback) and, on success, sets bit 1 of 0x0000c5e4 (OSK running). Returns nothing. Side effects: OSK, flag. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_update_dialog).

Columns of card-view row: rows 0-2 the main columns 0x0000c5fa, row 3 the main remainder (main count - 3 x columns), row 4 the extra columns 0x0000c5fc, row 5 the extra remainder, row 6 the side count; at least 7. No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_handle_card_input).

Returns the 6-byte entry under the card cursor: rows 0-3 main entries 0x0000c600 + 6 x (column + row x main columns), rows 4-5 extra entries 0x0000c7c2, row 6 side entries 0x0000c768; 0 when outside the counts. No side effects. Callers: 3 (deck_recipe_viewer_run_card_viewer, deck_recipe_viewer_handle_card_input, deck_recipe_viewer_update_cursor_card).

When the cursor card's id differs from the text-panel record 0x0000c8e0, stores it there and resets the scroll word 0x0000c8e8. Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x0000c8e0, 0x0000c8e8. Callers: 2 (deck_recipe_viewer_handle_list_input, deck_recipe_viewer_handle_card_input).

Advances the card reveal counter 0x0000c81c towards the total card count of the view by max(1, total / 15) per frame, clamped to the total. Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x0000c81c. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_update).

Gathers the selection of the current tab (imported deck: struct and record; recipe: deck_load_recipe, deck_get_recipe_card_list and deck_get_recipe_name; stored deck: struct +0x54, card list +0x114, name +4) and, when the load callback 0x0000e12c is set, calls it with (deck, card list, name or record, owner). Returns nothing. Side effects: those of the callback (rel_deck: deck_load_deck_into_editor). Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_update_dialog).

Returns bit 1 of 0x0000c81d, set by deck_recipe_viewer_start when its owner argument is not 1 (another character's deck). No side effects. Callers: 9 (deck_recipe_viewer_count_owned_copies, deck_recipe_viewer_start, deck_recipe_viewer_set_tab_frames, 0x00003be0, ...).

Returns the owner stored by deck_recipe_viewer_start (u16 0x0000c81e). No side effects. Callers: 4 (deck_recipe_viewer_count_owned_copies, deck_recipe_viewer_load_into_editor, deck_recipe_viewer_start, deck_recipe_viewer_build_deck_view).
Number of selectable tabs: 1 in owner mode or mode 1, 2 when no deck was imported, else 3. No side effects. Callers: 2 (deck_recipe_viewer_handle_list_input, 0x0000520c).

Prepares the dialog list window 0x0000e138 (0x120 bytes, heap 0x0000e11c): type 1 word 0x66, 2 word 0x67, 4 word 0x64 and 6 word 0x65 as two-choice prompts, 3 word 0x6b with one button, 5 a two-item menu (0xe8 x 0x13 items, callback deck_recipe_viewer_draw_menu_item); type 0 only resets the fields. Opens it centred on the 480 x 272 screen (ui_open_list_window) and stores type in bits 2-9 of 0x0000c5e4. Returns nothing. Side effects: window, 0x0000c5e4. Callers: 3 (deck_recipe_viewer_handle_list_input, deck_recipe_viewer_save_to_slot, deck_recipe_viewer_update_dialog).

Updates the dialog window 0x0000e138; when it returns a result, resets it, clears the type and acts: type 1 yes loads the selection into the editor (deck_recipe_viewer_load_into_editor) and returns 1; 2 yes goes to state 5 (save to slot); 3 returns 1; 4 yes deletes the stored deck; 5 item 1 opens dialog 4 (sound shown by Ghidra as a thunk address), item 0 starts the rename; 6 yes returns 1. Returns 1 when the viewer should close, else 0. Side effects: dialog, state, save data, callbacks. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_update).
Draws the dialog window 0x0000e138 (ui_draw_list_window with a pointer to list) and returns the advanced list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_draw).

column2: void deck_recipe_viewer_draw_menu_item(void *list, uint item, int y, int x)
column3: Item callback of the options menu (dialog 5): builds a 16-byte item from the 6-byte record 0x0000c048 + 6 x item (icon resource id, u, v, dictionary word; size 17 x 17) and draws it with shop_draw_menu_item_box(list, item, y, x + 1, 0xe8). Returns nothing. Side effects: GE and font commands. No direct caller (window callback set by deck_recipe_viewer_open_dialog).

Sub-module draw: clears layer 0 to black; nothing more in states 1 and 7. While the card viewer draws (0x0000c5e5 bit 3) calls ui_card_viewer_draw. Otherwise on layer 4: in state 0 the save-import message (save_import_update_message); else background, title, tabs, 0x0000476c, 0x0000482c, the deck cards (deck_recipe_viewer_draw_deck_cards), 0x00003ad0 and 0x00005468, in state 4 a dimming of the list around the selected row, the blinking list cursor (shop_draw_cursor_frame, resource 0x8006) unless the save blink hides it, the card detail panel (ui_draw_card_detail_view_temp with 0x0000c8e0) and the dialog when open; then either updates the OSK (ui_update_osk_input(4), clearing 0x0000c5e4 bit 1 when done) or draws the fade. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE layers, OSK. Callers: exported; module callers via import stubs: rel_story (1: world_state_update_recipe_viewer), rel_deck (1: ui_draw_deck_editor_frame), rel_title (1: ui_title_draw_state).

When resource 0x8021 is loaded plays it (ui_ehf_begin_draw / ui_ehf_draw with the frame timing / ui_ehf_end_draw), then enables texturing, sets the texture function and alpha blending. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_draw).

When resource 0x1011 is loaded plays it and draws the mode's title (dictionary word from the u16 table 0x0000c054 indexed by mode) in white at scale 0xc fitted to 0x80 px at (0x9d, 3). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_draw).

column2: void ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper: system_font_draw_text_fit_width(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text, -1) as a tail call (Ghidra shows an empty body). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 6 (0x00003be0, 0x000044e0, 0x0000405c, 0x0000520c, ...).

When resource 0x1010 is loaded plays it (EHF draw with the frame timing) and then draws the tab labels (0x0000520c). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_draw).

Draws the card grid of the selected deck from the deck view 0x0000c5fe, limited to the first 0x0000c81c entries (reveal counter). Main deck: its count (header bits 0-6) as 2 small digits at (0x1cd, 3) (shop_draw_small_digits, resource 0x8009), then rows 0-3 at y 0xf, 0x30, 0x51, 0x72 with 0x0000c5fa cards per row from the 6-byte entries at 0x0000c600. Extra deck: count (header bits 11-15) at (0x1cd, 0x92), rows 4-5 at y 0x9e, 0xbf (0x0000c5fc per row, entries 0x0000c7c2). Side deck: count (bits 7-10) at (0x1cd, 0xdf), one row (row 6) at y 0xeb (entries 0x0000c768). Card x = 300 + column x 0xaf / 7 when a row has fewer than 8 cards, else 300 + column x 0x98 / (cards - 1). Each card is drawn with deck_recipe_viewer_draw_card(list, x, y, entry); in the card-grid state (state bits 4-11 of 0x0000c5e0 = 4) the card under the cursor (column 0x0000c5f8, row 0x0000c5f9) is skipped and drawn last, followed by the cursor corners (deck_recipe_viewer_draw_card_cursor). Returns nothing usable. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_draw).

Draws the deck list of the current tab: the row drawer from the 3-entry pointer table 0x0000c05c (stored decks, recipes, imported decks) is called for the 8 visible entries (first visible + i) at x 0x97, y 0x24 + 0x1d x i; then the scrollbar (deck_recipe_viewer_draw_scrollbar at (0x11c, 0x2d), height 0xd6, 8 visible) over 50 stored decks, the recipe count 0x0000c900 or the import count 0x0000d908. Returns nothing (Ghidra drops the list pointer). Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_draw).

column2: void * deck_recipe_viewer_draw_stored_deck_row(void *list, int index, int x, int y)
column3: Row drawer for stored decks (entry 0 of the table 0x0000c05c): draws the row panel from resource 0x1001 (pieces 0x67, 0x18 and 6 px wide, 0x1e high, texture row v 0x60 in owner mode, else 0) at (x, y); in black at scale 0xc, an empty slot (word 0 of save_get_stored_deck(index) is 0) shows the placeholder string 0x0000c068 centred in 100 px at y + 9, a used one its name (+4) fitted to 0x6e px at (x + 0x10, y + 3) and its timestamp (+0x44, deck_recipe_viewer_draw_timestamp) at (x + 0x10, y + 0x10). Then a 10 x 14 icon at (x + 3, y + 2): from resource 0x800a (texture 0x36, 0x23) normally, from resource 0x1001 (0x71, 0x31) in owner mode; and when the list record (8 bytes at 0x0000d772 + 8 x index) has a non-zero total (+6) equal to its owned count (+5), a 22 x 24 complete mark (resource 0x800a, texture 0x66, 0x11) at (x + 0x6e, y + 4). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE and font commands. No direct caller (row-drawer table 0x0000c05c).

column2: void ui_window_draw_text_px(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text); text is passed through in its register (hidden by the decompiler). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 2 (deck_recipe_viewer_draw_stored_deck_row, deck_recipe_viewer_draw_timestamp).

column2: void * deck_recipe_viewer_draw_recipe_row(void *list, int index, int x, int y)
column3: Row drawer for recipes (entry 1 of the table 0x0000c05c); nothing when index >= the recipe count 0x0000c900. Draws the row panel (resource 0x1001, v 0x60 in owner mode, else 0x20), the recipe name (deck_get_recipe_name of the u16 at 0x0000c902 + 8 x index) in black at scale 0xc fitted to 0x6e px at (x + 0x10, y + 3), and at scale 10 the character name world_get_character_name_string_first(0, byte +4 of the record) fitted to 0x5c px at (x + 0x14, y + 0x10). Outside owner mode: icon 10 x 14 from resource 0x800a (texture 0x47, 0x23) at (x + 3, y + 2), the complete mark (22 x 24, texture 0x66, 0x11) at (x + 0x6e, y + 4) when the record's total (+6) is non-zero and equals its owned count (+5), and the u16 at +2 as 3 zero-padded small digits (style 0x303, resource 0x8009) at (x, y + 0x11). In owner mode: the icon from resource 0x1001 (0x71, 0x31) and the complete mark tested on the stored-deck records 0x0000d777/0x0000d778 + 8 x index instead of the recipe record (looks like a copy of the stored-deck row code). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE and font commands. No direct caller (row-drawer table 0x0000c05c).

column2: void *deck_recipe_viewer_draw_imported_row(void *list, int index, int x, int y)
column3: Row drawer for imported decks (entry 2 of 0x0000c05c): when index is below the import count draws the row panel from resource 0x1001 (v 0x40: 0x67 + 0x18 + 6 px pieces), the deck name (import buffer 0x0000d904 + 0x1c0 x index) in black at scale 0xc fitted to 0x6e px, a 10 x 14 icon from resource 0x800a and, when the record's total (0x0000d912 + 8 x index) is non-zero and equals its owned count (+0x0000d911), a 22 x 24 complete mark. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE and font commands. No direct caller (row-drawer table 0x0000c05c).

Draws the 7 frame-category counters 0x0000e10c as 2-digit numbers (shop_draw_small_digits, resource 0x8009) at x 0x7a (0x77 for one digit), y 9 + 0x13 x i. Returns nothing (Ghidra drops the list pointer). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_draw).

Splits a 0x82-px vertical bar starting at y 6 into segments proportional to the 7 counters 0x0000e10c and draws each non-empty one at x 0x8d with deck_recipe_viewer_draw_frame_segment. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_draw).

column2: void *deck_recipe_viewer_draw_frame_segment(void *list, int x, int y, int length, int category)
column3: Draws a 3 x length segment by stretching one texel of resource 0x800a: (0, 0x7a + category) for categories 0-3, (3, 0x7a) for 4, (0, 0x79 + category) above. Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged without the resource). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_draw_frame_bar).

column2: void deck_recipe_viewer_draw_timestamp(void *list, int x, int y, ushort *stamp)
column3: Draws a five-field timestamp in black at scale 9 x 10: stamp[0] % 100, stamp[1] and stamp[2] separated by the 2-character string at 0x0000c080, then stamp[3] ':' stamp[4], each as 2 zero-padded digits (shop_draw_number_plain, step 6) from x + 0xc to x + 0x4e. Returns nothing. Side effects: font commands. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_draw_stored_deck_row).

column2: void deck_recipe_viewer_draw_card(void *list, int x, int y, void *entry)
column3: Draws a deck-view entry: thumbnail (shop_draw_card_thumb with resources 0x8001, 0x8002, 0x8032), badges (shop_draw_card_badges, limit mode = owner mode) and, when the entry's available flag (byte 5 bit 1) is clear, a 0x16 x 0x1e half-transparent black shade over it. Returns nothing (Ghidra drops the list pointer). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_draw_deck_cards).

Draws the card cursor as four 10 x 10 corner sprites of resource 0x8008 (texture (0, 0x5c), (0x11, 0x5c), (0, 0x6c), (0x11, 0x6c)) around the card at (x, y), pulsing outwards by 0-3 px with the frame counter. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_draw_deck_cards).

column2: void * deck_recipe_viewer_draw_scrollbar(void *list, int x, int y, int height, int top, int visible, int count)
column3: Draws a vertical scrollbar from resource 0x8007 (texture column u 0x77); arguments 5-7 travel in t0-t2. Track: 8 x 5 caps at (x, y) (v 0) and (x, y + height - 5) (v 0xf) with the 8 x 5 texel middle (v 5) stretched to height - 10. Thumb: when count > visible its length is visible x (height - 2) / count (at least 10) and its offset top x (height - 2 - length) / (count - visible) clamped to the free length, otherwise the full height - 2 at offset 0; drawn as 4 x 5 caps (v 0x14 and 0x23) and a stretched middle (v 0x19) at x + 2. Then two arrows (shop_draw_scroll_arrow, period ui_ehf_get_frame_rate(), frame counter, image 0x8007): up at (x, y - 7) blinking when top > 0, down at (x, y + height + 2) blinking when top < count - visible. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_draw_deck_list).
Returns the frame rate, word +4 of the frame timing record (system_get_frame_timing()). No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_draw_scrollbar).

Draws the labels of the deck_recipe_viewer_get_tab_count() tabs at x 0xa4 + step x i (2 tabs: width 0x36, step 0x49; otherwise width 0x5f, step 0x11, i.e. overlapping tabs). The current tab (bits 0-1 of 0x0000c5ea), and every tab in owner mode, is white at y 0x16; the others are grey 0xff808080 at y 0x18. With 3 tabs a tab behind the current one is clipped to its visible strip (the right 0xd or 0xb px, or 2 px) or skipped. Each label is drawn under a scissor (x, 0x16 + offset, visible width, 0xb - offset) at scale 0xc with ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit: dictionary word (resource 0x8033) from the u16 table 0x0000c084 at [label x 2 + (count != 2)], where the label is the tab index, or 3 for tab 0 in owner mode. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 1 (deck_recipe_viewer_draw_tabs).
